chapter.verse: Tua mun panin Zeisu tho a, Judah gam leh Jordan gun gal khatah a tung hi. Mi tampi in ama kiangah kikhawm kik uh a, a ngeina bangin thu a hilh hi.
Farisaite in Zeisu kiangah va nai uh a, “Mi in a zi a mak tuak hiam?” ci-in a ze-et nadingun thu a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Moses in note tungah bang thu hong pia hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Kikhenna lai pia-in zi mak nading thu hong pia hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note na lungsim uh khauh lua ahih ciangin, Moses in tua thukhamna a gelh hi.
Ahih hangin a kipat cil panin pasal leh numei a piangsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, pasal in a nu a pa nusia-in a zi a beel ding hi.
Tua nihte in sakhat pumkhat a suak ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin, amaute in nih hi loin, mi khat bek ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in a kigawmsakte mite in kikhensak kei uh hen,” a ci hi.
Amaute in inn sungah a om lai takun a nungzuite in hih thu a dong kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “A zi ma a, numei dang tawh a kiteeng peuhmah in numei tungah a mawh hi.
Numei in zong, a pasal ma a, pasal dang tawh a kiteen’ leh, a pasal thak tungah a mawh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin naupangte a lawn’ nading deihin Zeisu kiangah hong paipih uh a, a nungzuite in a kham uh hi.
Zeisu in a muh ciangin heh a, “Naupangte omsak ta un. Ka kiangah hong pai ding uh kham kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian Gam in tua bangte gam ahi hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, naupang bangin Pasian Gam a sang lo mi peuhmah in tua gam sungah a lut kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in thu a gen hi.
Tua khit ciangin naupang tawi a, amaute tungah a khut nga-in thupha a pia hi.
Lampi-ah a pai lai takin mi khat Zeisu kiangah va tai a, khukdin’in, “Sia pha aw, nuntak tawntungna ka luah nadingin bang ka gamta ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Bang hangin kei mipha hong ci na hi hiam? Pasian sim loh mipha khat beek a om kei hi.
Thukhamte na thei hi. Mi na that kei in. Mi’ zi tawh na mawh kei in. Mi’ sum na gu kei in. Ahi lo teci na pang kei in. A kilawm loin mi’ sum na laksak kei in. Na nu leh na pa na zahtak in,” a ci hi.
Tua pa in, “Sia aw, tua thu khempeuh ka neu lai akipan ka tang zo hi,” a ci hi.

Zeisu in tua pa a et ciangin it a, “Na khat na sam lai hi. Pai in la, na neihsa teng zuakin mizawngte na pia in. Tua ahih leh, vantung gam sungah sum na nei ding hi. Tua khit ciangin ka nung hong zui in,” a ci hi.
Tua pa in tua thu hangin a mai khing a, lungkim loin a paikhia hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, sum tampi a nei hi.
Zeisu in a kimkot en a, “Sum tam a neite adingin Pasian Gam sung lut nading a haksa mahmah hi,” ci-in a nungzuite kiangah a gen hi.
A nungzuite in ama thu lamdang a sa uh hi. Khatvei Zeisu in, “Ka tate aw, sum leh pai a suangte in Pasian Gam sungah a tum nading bangzah tak a haksa hiam?
Sai khat phim bil vangah a khum hak sangin, sum hau mite Pasian Gam sungah lut nading a haksa zaw hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi. “Tua bang ahih leh, gupna kua in ngah zo ding hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute enin, “Hih thu mite in ahih zo kei uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in ahih theih loh a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in na khempeuh ahih thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in, “Kote in ka neihsa khempeuh uh nusia-in nangmah kong zui uh hi,” ci-in gen ding a kipat ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kei hang ahi zongin, Lungdamna Thu hang ahi zongin a inn, a sanggampa, a sanggamnu, a nu a pa,

a lo a nusiat leh, tu lai takin a zah zakhat innte, sanggampate, sanggamnute, nute, pate, tate, lote, bawlsiatna tawh ngah a, nung ciangin hong piang ding hunah nuntak tawntungna ngah lo ding kuamah a om kei hi.
Ahih hangin a masate tampi in a nunung ding uh hi. A nunung mi tampite in a masa ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute Jerusalem khua paina lampi ah a pai lai takun, Zeisu in a nungzuite mai-ah a pai masa hi. Amaute in lamdang sa uh a, a nung zui mite in a lau uh hi.

Tua lai takin Zeisu in sawm-le-nihte sam kik a, “En un, eite Jerusalem khuapi ah i pai ding hi. Mihing Tapa in siampi liante leh laitheite’ khut tungah a kipia ding hi. Amaute in ama sih nadingin thu a khen khit uh ciangin, Gentailte’ khut tungah a pia ding uh hi.
Tua mite in zong amah zahkoin, cil tawh phihin, satin, a that ding uh hi. Ni thum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi,” ci-in ama tungah a tung ding thute a nungzuite kiangah a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Zebedi’ tapa Jakob leh Johan-te in Zeisu kiangah pai uh a, “Sia aw, nangma kiangah kong nget peuh uh nong piak nading ka deih uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note tungah kong piak ding bang na deih uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin,
“Topa aw, na minthan’na sungah kote na taklam khat, na veilam khat ka tut theih nadingun thu hong pia in,” ci-in a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in nong ngetna uh na thei kei uh hi. Ka dawn ding hai dawn zo ding na hi uh hiam? Ka thuak ding baptaizna thuak zo ding na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
“Ka hih zo uh hi,” a cih uh ciangin, Zeisu in, “Ka dawn ding hai na dawn takpi ding uh hi. Ka thuak ding baptaizna zong na thuak ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka taklam leh ka veilamah tut nading ke’n thu kong pia thei kei ding hi. A ngah dinga a bawlsate in a ngah ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzui sawmte in a zak uh ciangin, Jakob leh Johan tungah a heh uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute sam a, “Gentailte tungah uk ding a kilawmte in a mang uh a, miliante in thu neihna tawh a uk uh note in na thei uh hi.
Note lakah tua bang a hi kei ding hi. Note lakah milian a suak nuamte in nomau nasem suak uh hen.
Note lakah makai a suak nuamte in note sila suak uh hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Mihing Tapa in midangte na semsak dingin hong pai ahi kei hi. Midangte’ na sem ding a, mi tampi tankhia ding leh, a nuntakna pia dingin hong pai ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Jerikho khuapi tung uh a, Zeisu in a nungzuite akipan mihonpite tawh Jerikho khuapi pan a paikhiat lai takun, Timeus’ tapa Bartimai a min nei, mittaw khutdawh ngen khat lampi geiah a tu hi.
Nazareth mi Zeisu ahih thu a zak ciangin, “David’ Tapa Zeisu aw, kei hong hehpih in,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Mihonpite in a daih nadingin a taai uh hangin, “David’ Tapa aw, kei hong hehpih in,” ci-in a kiko sawnsawn hi.
Zeisu ding-in, “Tua pa vasam un,” a ci hi. Amaute in mittawpa sam uh a, “Nuam in la, tho in, nang hong sam hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amah in a puan a paih khit ciangin thakhatin ding-in Zeisu kiangah a pai hi.
Zeisu in, “Nang ading bang kong bawl ding deih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Topa aw, ka mittang’ khua muh nading ka deih hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Pai in, na upna in hong damsak zo hi,” a ci hi. Amah in thakhatin khua mu thei a, lampi ah Zeisu nung a zui hi.
